links.outcome: Generative LLMs vs in-house fine-tuned model on ADR relation prediction F1 and recall
links.effect: On MIMIC-Unrestricted, Gemini 1.5 Pro F1 0.724 to 0.863 and recall 0.675 to 0.943; Llama 3.1 405B F1 0.724 to 0.814 and recall 0.675 to 0.948 versus BioM-ELECTRA-Large.
links.quote: Notably, on the MIMIC-Unrestricted dataset, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Llama 3.1 405B outperform our in-house fine-tuned BioM-ELECTRA-Large, with Gemini 1.5 Pro showing a 19.2% (0.724-0.863) improvement in F1 score and a 39.7% (0.675-0.943) increase in recall, while Llama 3.1 405B exhibits a 12.4% (0.724-0.814) improvement in F1 and a 40.4% (0.675-0.948) boost in recall.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid pipeline using a fine-tuned model to pre-filter segments for generative LLM prediction to improve precision and save compute

screen.reason: Evaluates generative LLMs and a hybrid NLP pipeline for adverse drug reaction relation extraction on benchmark datasets (such as MIMIC) without testing clinical deployment practices or guardrails.
